Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.

This is an application for recall of the order dated 22.11.2017, whereby the Application under
Section 482 Cr.P.C. was dismissed for want of prosecution.
2.  I have gone through the affidavit filed in support of this application.
The order dated 22.11.2017 is recalled and Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is restored to its original number.

Order Date :- 23.9.2019 AK Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 7366 of 2003 Applicant :- Suresh Chand Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Sharma,B.N. Agarwal,Sanjay Agrawal Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,Pradeep Suresh Chand vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130410293/
1 Chauhan Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
The application is restored to its original number vide order of date passed on recall application.

2. Heard Sri Sanjay Agarwal, learned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. for State.
3.

Applicant has invoked jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 (hereinafter referred to as "Cr.P.C.") with a prayer to quash the proceedings pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate First, Agra in Case No. 96 of 2002, under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954"), Police Station Kotwali, District Agra.

entities.text: Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate First, Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. It is contended that a perusal of complaint filed by Nagar Swasthya Adhikari, Nagar Nigam, Agra (Annexure-7 to writ petition) read with Public Analyst Report dated 28.06.2001 show that allegation against applicant is that he has violated Rule 32 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955 (hereinafter referred to as "Rules, 1955") in respect of non mention of packaging month, batch number and best before months or year.

It is submitted that aforesaid information was required to be furnished under Rule 32(b) and aforesaid provision, as it was in 2001 when complaint has been filed, was already declared ultra vires by Supreme court in Dwarka Nath and another vs. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi, AIR 1971 SC 1844 and, therefore, proceedings initiated against applicant are in respect of an offence under the provision which is already declared ultra vires.
5.

entities.text: Dwarka Nath and another vs. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi, AIR 1971 SC 1844
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A., when questioned, could not dispute that though there were some amendments made in Rule 32(b) but the same are of subsequent period and in 2001 there was no change.
In these circumstances, proceedings having been initiated under the provision which has already been declared ultra vires and cannot be sustained.
6. In view of above, application is accordingly allowed.

Proceedings in Case No. 96 of 2002, under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, Police Station Kotwali, District Agra, pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate First, Agra, are hereby quashed.
